a: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
p: Alladhī khalaqanī fa-huwa yahdīn, wa-lladhī huwa yuṭʿimunī wa yasqīn, wa idhā mariḍtu fa-huwa yashfīn.
m: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me. And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink. And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
